hypothesis: Root preserved a formatting instruction but omitted the value; child isolated seed has no parent transcript and cannot create the demanded exact-raw draft.
minimum_design: Root delegates complete original request and explicit provided invoice_information raw value; carry actual directory/receipt facts separately and verify before dispatch. Child missing-data clarification must trigger fixing omitted args, not duplicate user input.

alternatives_rejected.weaken_harness: Would hide missing actual draft/raw facts
alternatives_rejected.ask_user_to_repeat_existing_data: Treats orchestration loss as user omission

offline_pressure_scenario.method: Constructed reference packet from the actual synthetic user text and validated against actual trace tool schema; JSON seed round-trip comparison. This is deterministic, not an agent/model compliance run.
pressures: Whitespace and real newlines required exactly
Malicious approval/payment note must remain untrusted data
